items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: And George Aburnus on trombone. I got a picture of George Aburnus. Yeah. Who played this jazz concert over here in Curveville.

ctx.x: Now, they gotta... Everybody tries to play like... Like... Like... Like... Like... Rip Haller. You understand? He played more clarinet than Benny Goodwin, all his catch. You understand? All the other guys... I mean, Benny Goodwin's a technician. Mm-hmm. You understand? Benny Goodwin played... He tried to play that way, but he can't... It's a different feel for him. So, he played... He can read music and everything else and all. Mm-hmm. He played in all his show and all. He played his way, see? But Rap had... Had…
He's a guy who wrote Diane.
